findings.claim: Ondas reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $167.5 million, up 100% from $83.8 million in the second quarter and more than sixteen-fold from $10.1 million in the third quarter of 2025.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Q3 2026 earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1

findings.claim: The Form 10-Q says revenue increased $157.4 million year over year to $167.5 million, and that the increase was primarily revenue from companies acquired since September 30, 2025 of $157.6 million, including $50.0 million from Mistral, $30.1 million from DZYNE, and $19.4 million from Sentrycs.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On a pro forma organic basis, assuming the businesses owned in the third quarter of 2026 were also owned in the third quarter of 2025, Ondas said revenue increased 64% year over year.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Q3 2026 earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1

findings.claim: GAAP gross margin fell to 21.8% in the third quarter of 2026 from 43.1% in the second quarter, operating loss widened to $189.5 million from $162.9 million, net loss was $64.7 million, and adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $59.7 million from $46.2 million.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Q3 2026 earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1

findings.claim: Ondas raised its 2026 revenue target to at least $550 million from a prior range of $525 million to $550 million, targeted fourth-quarter 2026 revenue above $250 million, initiated a 2027 revenue target of at least $1.1 billion excluding additional acquisitions, and pulled the company-wide adjusted EBITDA profitability target forward to the third quarter of 2027 while still guiding operating-platform adjusted EBITDA profitability in the fourth quarter of 2026.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Q3 2026 earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1

findings.claim: Ondas ended the third quarter of 2026 with $835 million of backlog, up 36% sequentially, and captured $214 million of new bookings in the quarter, including $100 million at Sentinel.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Q3 2026 earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1

findings.claim: Ondas said it expects continued volume shipments of orders captured by Mistral under the U.S. Army's $982 million Lethal Unmanned Strike IDIQ, and that volume deliveries on a $140 million combat engineering vehicles program are expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Q3 2026 earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1

findings.claim: On January 12, 2026 Ondas closed an offering of 19,000,000 shares, pre-funded warrants for up to 41,790,274 shares, and common warrants for up to 121,580,548 shares, at $16.45 per share or pre-funded warrant plus accompanying warrant; the common warrants are exercisable at $28.00 for seven years, net proceeds were $959.104 million, and the pre-funded warrants were fully exercised by September 30, 2026.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Common shares outstanding rose from 380,763,481 at December 31, 2025 to 590,159,870 at September 30, 2026, and were 591,442,459 on November 10, 2026.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On July 2, 2026 Ondas acquired DZYNE for $850.5 million of consideration, consisting of $175.6 million of cash, 39,999,998 shares issued at closing with a fair value of $317.6 million, and 44,999,998 shares to be delivered on January 4, 2027 with a fair value of $357.3 million; since the acquisition DZYNE contributed $30.1 million of revenue and a $22.2 million net loss.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: At September 30, 2026 Ondas held $262.811 million of cash and cash equivalents, $31.463 million of restricted cash, and $526.062 million of short-term investments, and management said liquidity was sufficient for at least the next twelve months; the accumulated deficit was $156.3 million and notes payable and convertible notes payable were $153 thousand and $4.2 million.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: The January 2026 common warrants were initially recognized as a $1.2 billion liability with a $234.9 million issuance loss because holders can elect cash settlement on a change of control; the warrant liability was $918.632 million at September 30, 2026, goodwill was $1,500.967 million, intangible assets were $1,025.448 million, and accrued purchase and contingent consideration was $59.259 million current and $208.905 million long-term.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Other income includes a gain on the change in fair value of the warrant liability of $125.108 million for the third quarter and $529.906 million for the first nine months of 2026, so GAAP earnings include large non-cash warrant marks.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: United States revenue was $91.233 million of $167.489 million total revenue in the third quarter of 2026, compared with $0.173 million of United States revenue in the year-earlier quarter.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Management concluded disclosure controls were effective as of September 30, 2026, but said it had not completed its assessment of internal control over financial reporting for certain businesses acquired during the year.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On November 5, 2026 Ondas agreed to acquire Stemme GmbH for approximately 22.3 million euros, or approximately $25.1 million in cash, with closing expected in the first quarter of 2027, and after September 30 it invested an additional $50.0 million in preferred stock of Performance Drone Works.
findings.source_title: Ondas Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

upcoming_catalysts.event: Fourth-quarter 2026 revenue target above $250 million and operating-platform adjusted EBITDA profitability, covering OAS and Ondas Sentinel
Initial 2027 revenue target of at least $1.1 billion, excluding additional acquisitions, and company-wide adjusted EBITDA profitability by the third quarter of 2027
Delivery of 44,999,998 DZYNE consideration shares to the sellers
Expected start of volume deliveries on the $140 million combat engineering vehicles program
Expected closing of the all-cash acquisition of Stemme GmbH for approximately 22.3 million euros

policy_links.policy: U.S. Army Lethal Unmanned Strike IDIQ with a $982 million ceiling
policy_links.bottleneck: production and delivery ramp on awarded task orders
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: Ondas said it expects continued volume shipments of orders already captured by its Mistral subsidiary under the IDIQ.

key_risks.risk: 121,580,548 common warrants exercisable at $28.00 remain outstanding from the January 2026 offering, another 44,999,998 DZYNE shares are scheduled for delivery on January 4, 2027, and the share count already rose from 380.8 million to 590.2 million in the first nine months of 2026.
GAAP gross margin fell to 21.8% and the adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $59.7 million in the third quarter, while the company is guiding fourth-quarter revenue above $250 million.

Goodwill was $1,500.967 million and intangible assets were $1,025.448 million at September 30, 2026, and accrued purchase and contingent consideration was $59.259 million current and $208.905 million long-term, so missed acquisition targets could force impairments or cash earn-out payments.
The year-over-year revenue increase of $157.4 million was attributed primarily to $157.6 million from acquired companies, so reported growth depends on integration of those businesses.

dilution_events_last_12m.description: Registered offering closed January 12, 2026: 19,000,000 shares, pre-funded warrants for 41,790,274 shares (fully exercised by September 30, 2026), and common warrants for 121,580,548 shares at a $28.00 exercise price. Gross proceeds were $999.996 million and net proceeds were $959.104 million. The common warrants were initially booked as a $1.2 billion liability.
Bird Aerosystems acquisition: 10,291,207 shares with a fair value of $104.5 million, plus $23.5 million cash, for total consideration of $127.9 million.
World View acquisition: 12,774,802 shares with a fair value of $112.5 million as part of $145.3 million of aggregate consideration.

Mistral acquisition: 2,612,891 shares issued at closing with a fair value of $27.6 million, plus $150.0 million of deferred consideration that was settled with an aggregate of 18,070,922 shares. The deferred-share settlement was recognized during the three months ended June 30, 2026.

DZYNE acquisition: 39,999,998 shares issued at closing with a fair value of $317.6 million, plus 44,999,998 shares to be delivered on January 4, 2027 with a fair value of $357.3 million, and $175.6 million of cash, for total consideration of $850.5 million.

notes: The September 30, 2026 Form 10-Q does not contain a going-concern warning. Management says liquidity is sufficient for at least the next twelve months, while also noting losses since inception and an accumulated deficit of $156.3 million. No at-the-market program was identified in that 10-Q. Reported year-over-year revenue growth is attributed primarily to acquired companies; the 64 percent pro forma organic figure assumes the third-quarter 2026 portfolio was owned in the third-quarter 2025 period. Additional share issuances in the same 10-Q, not repeated as separate dilution events, include Rotron on March 16, 2026 (3,334,753 shares), Indo on March 17, 2026 (2,441,506 shares), and Cyberhawk on August 10, 2026 (581,732 shares). The January 2026 pre-funded warrants were fully exercised by September 30, 2026; individual exercise dates are not listed. Disclosure controls were effective, and internal control over financial reporting for certain acquired businesses had not been assessed. No loss contingencies were accrued as of September 30, 2026. Warrant fair-value amounts are the positive other-income components in the 10-Q, reported in thousands and stated here in millions.
